bosses.name: The Golden Serpent
positioning: Drop Spit Gold puddles next to the ones already down so they merge into fewer Animated Gold
everyone: Spit Gold hits two players; use a defensive if you're low
Lucre's Call wakes the puddles as Animated Gold: slow, stun, and cleave them before they reach the boss
tank: Tail Thrash is a modest tank hit
healer: Serpentine Gust is a long group channel: plan a healing cooldown for each one
damage: Cleave the Animated Gold down the moment it spawns

bosses.name: Mchimba the Embalmer
positioning: Drop Burn Corruption fire away from the boss and the four sarcophagi so paths stay open
When someone is entombed, spread out across the room to find the sarcophagus that shakes
everyone: Entomb locks a player in one of four sarcophagi; the trapped player shakes it with the extra action button, and the group opens the right one before more mummies wake
Step out of Drain Fluids circles; if Drain Fluids targets you, a defensive or combat drop stops it
Be at full health before Awakening Slam
healer: If Drain Fluids finishes, heal its target above 90% to clear the debuff
Top everyone before Awakening Slam
damage: Cleave the two Half-Finished Mummies from Awakening Slam and interrupt their Wretched Discharge

bosses.name: The Council of Tribes
positioning: Tank Kula in the middle of the arena: her Whirling Axes keep firing from her body after she dies
Group up in one safe spot for the Barrel Through soak, which continues after Aka'ali dies
everyone: Dodge the opening AoE and the spinning Whirling Axes
When Call the Elements casts, kill the totems in order: Explosive, then Thundering, then Torrent
tank: Debilitating Backhand knocks you back and makes you take more damage: kite until it fades or use a big defensive
healer: Arc Lightning hits the group and always the tank
Severing Axe bleeds a random player: cleanse the bleed or focus heals on them
damage: Keep Poison Nova interrupted

bosses.name: Dazar, The First King
positioning: Point the boss away from the group during Gilded Destruction: his swings become frontals while it lasts
Spread for Aerial Smash so the two hits don't overlap
everyone: Kill Reban first, before the boss empowers at 80%
Dodge Reban's Hunting Leap frontal and avoid Impaling Spear circles
Once mounted, Aerial Smash becomes Quaking Leap on four players with extra AoE; the farthest target can cancel it with a combat drop
tank: Blade Combo ramps over a short channel: use a defensive
Savage Maul comes right before Blade Combo while mounted; cleanse the bleed if you can
healer: Gilded Destruction and Quaking Leap are the heavy group damage windows
damage: Interrupt Reban's Deathly Roar and burn him first

enemies.name: Interment Construct
enemies.threat: Every melee swing it lands hits the whole group, and Entomb ramps group damage until the trapped player is freed
positioning: Pull it away from other big packs: its Heavy Slams damage stacks with everything else in the pull
everyone: Heavy Slams: each melee hit on the tank deals physical damage to all players, so the group takes damage the whole time it's alive
Entomb seals a player in a crypt and starts Wail of Mourning, group shadow damage that grows every tick until they're released
If you're entombed, press the extra action button so your crypt shakes; everyone else finds that crypt and opens it right away
Immune to crowd control, so plan defensives instead of stuns
tank: You're fine because you take normal melee; your group isn't. Kiting it for a few seconds stops its swings and pauses Heavy Slams when the group is low
Don't chain it into Embalming Fluid or other packs while Entomb is out
healer: Expect steady group damage from Heavy Slams, then a spike while Wail of Mourning ramps: save a cooldown for each Entomb
Damage from it compounds with a second Construct or Animated Guardian below 50%
damage: Use personal defensives when Wail of Mourning stacks up, and help free the entombed player instead of tunneling

enemies.name: Animated Guardian
enemies.threat: Group-wide Heavy Slams that hit harder once it drops below 50%
positioning: Stand close so the random-target Suppression Slam frontal is easy to sidestep
everyone: Below 50% it gains Released Inhibitors and Heavy Slams hurts much more: save defensives for then
tank: Aim Suppression Slam away from the group
healer: Heavy Slams is constant group damage; it spikes after 50%

enemies.name: Purification Construct
enemies.threat: Heavy Slams group damage on top of a big Purification Strike hit
healer: Heavy Slams hits the group on every swing; watch for Purification Strike landing at the same time

enemies.name: Embalming Fluid
enemies.threat: Leaves poison circles when it dies
everyone: Step out of the circles it leaves on death
healer: Poison dispel anyone who gets caught

enemies.name: Risen Hexer
enemies.threat: Hex Volley needs an interrupt every time
everyone: Interrupt every Hex Volley; spare kicks go on Shadowfrost Bolt
healer: Dispel Shadowfrost Bolt's magic effect or use a freedom

enemies.name: Shadow-Borne Champion
enemies.threat: Shadow Whirlwind circles and an enrage
everyone: When Vigilant Defense points a shield at you, move behind it
damage: Soothe Ancestral Fury if you can

enemies.name: Seneschal M'bara
enemies.threat: Heals its pack with Unholy Mending
everyone: Interrupt every Unholy Mending; purge it if one lands

enemies.name: Guard Captain Atu
enemies.threat: Shields other enemies with Captain's Bulwark
everyone: Purge Captain's Bulwark off the other enemies, or crowd control Atu to delay it

enemies.name: Phantom Hex Priest
everyone: Interrupt or curse dispel every Hex; spare kicks go on Spectral Bolt

enemies.name: Spectral Shaman
everyone: Kill Healing Tide Totem the moment it appears
healer: Frost Shock slows a random player; dispel the magic or use a freedom

enemies.name: Royal Berserker
healer: Bloodthirsty Axe hits two random players: cleanse the bleed or heal through it

enemies.name: Ghostly Brute
enemies.threat: Soul Crush makes the tank take more damage
everyone: Stay out of Seismic Upheaval around it
tank: Use a defensive for Soul Crush

enemies.name: Honored Raptor
everyone: Sidestep Hunting Leap or stop it with crowd control

enemies.name: Skeletal Hunting Raptor
enemies.threat: Hunting Leap frontal through a random player

enemies.name: King Timalji
everyone: Immune to crowd control; shares health with Queen Wasi
Move away from others when Erupting Slam targets you
tank: Kite Bladestorm if it fixates you

enemies.name: Queen Wasi
enemies.threat: Bind Soul needs an interrupt every time
everyone: Immune to crowd control; shares health with King Timalji
Interrupt every Bind Soul; spare kicks go on Soul Bolt

enemies.name: Queen Patlaa
healer: Poison dispel Serpent Strike
damage: Soothe Bestial Berserk if you can

enemies.name: King A'akul
enemies.threat: Blood Drain hits bleeding players harder
tank: Mortal Bleed: use a defensive or bleed cleanse

enemies.name: Bloodsworn Assassin
everyone: Cleanse or defend against Sudden Rupture, especially before King A'akul's Blood Drain

enemies.name: King Rahu'ai
healer: Forked Lightning bounces through the group

enemies.name: Shadow of Zul
enemies.threat: Mini boss with soaks and Shadow Barrage
everyone: Stand in the two Pool of Darkness soaks quickly
Move away from the group when Dark Revelation targets you
damage: Purge or kill the Minions of Zul from Dark Revelation

enemies.name: Half-Finished Mummy
damage: Interrupt every Wretched Discharge

bosses.name: Kystia Manaheart
positioning: Face Nibbles away from the group so its rotating Fel Spray misses everyone
everyone: Ignore the boss's Felshield stacks and focus Nibbles, who turns friendly at 20%
Interrupt or crowd control the five Mirror Images
tank: Chaos Barrage hits you then jumps to others
healer: Dispel Corroding Spittle quickly, especially while Mirror Images are up
damage: Line up cooldowns with the damage-taken window

bosses.name: Zaen Bladesorrow
positioning: Each player hides behind their own barrel for Murder In A Row
everyone: Avoid the barrels from Same-Day Delivery
When Fire Bomb targets you, use it to break Fel-Infused Freight
tank: Use a defensive for Envenom; poison dispel it if you can
healer: Killing Spree is a heavy group channel, worse with Fel-Infused Freight still in the room

bosses.name: Xathuux the Annihilator
positioning: Tank the boss at the edge of the round arena, facing out, so Legion Strike points away
During Demonic Rage kite along the edge, using less than half the room each time
If Axe Toss targets you, stand beside the boss so the axe lands in cleave range
tank: Save a defensive for Infernal Crush when it overlaps Demonic Rage
damage: Swap to Legion Axe the moment it lands; its AoE keeps growing
Save cooldowns for the Demonic Rage window

bosses.name: Lithiel Cinderfury
positioning: Drag the boss far from the Infernal so it never blocks a gate
Spread for Fingers Of Gul'dan but let the circles overlap
Take the Demonic Gateway on the side safe from Malefic Wave
everyone: Kill every add before Malefic Wave reaches it
tank: The Infernal can't die and fixates you: keep it out of the way
Pick up the Vilefiend
healer: Searing Fel Flame pulses the whole fight
damage: Spare kicks and stuns on the Wild Imps' Felfire Burst

enemies.name: Corrupted Warlock
enemies.threat: Curse Of Doom summons a Doomguard if it kills someone
everyone: Dispel Curse Of Doom, or stack inside it to split the damage
Drain Life: defensive or combat drop

enemies.name: Shivan Punisher
enemies.threat: Demonic Frenzy at 50% means heavy pulsing group damage
healer: Plan a cooldown for when it hits 50%
damage: Burst it once Demonic Frenzy starts

enemies.name: Massive Felwyrm
enemies.threat: Constant pulsing damage and a big explosion on death
tank: Pick up the Felwyrms from Summon Wyrms
healer: Over-Infused pulses all fight; dispel Corroding Spittle

enemies.name: Felmaster Lucsei
enemies.threat: Blade Dance stacking damage and Eye Beam
tank: Aim Eye Beam away from the group
healer: Blade Dance stacks a DoT on everyone: cooldown it

enemies.name: Defiled Golem
enemies.threat: Defiled Slam channel and Fel Beam lines at every player
everyone: Avoid the puddles Fel Beam leaves
healer: Defiled Slam is heavy channelled group damage

enemies.name: Bribed Captain
enemies.threat: Buffs nearby enemies with Deep Corruption
tank: Watch Shield Bash stacks
damage: Kill it first

enemies.name: Felonious Mage
everyone: Interrupt or crowd control Fel Missiles
damage: Purge Fel Crazed

enemies.name: Fel Invoker
everyone: Interrupt or crowd control Health Funnel

enemies.name: Wrathguard Flayer
enemies.threat: Fel Rage enrage and Flay bleed

enemies.name: Street Sneak
enemies.threat: Heartstop Poison stacks on the tank
tank: Defensives or poison dispels for Heartstop Poison

enemies.name: Keen Taskmaster
tank: Soothe Back To Work! if your group can

enemies.name: Felwyrm
everyone: Avoid the death AoE from Fel Infused

bosses.name: Taz'Rah
positioning: Spread loosely near the edge for Nether Dash, a line through everyone
Keep the shades close together so their Umbral Rupture puddles clump
Keep rotating around the room after Umbral Rupture so Dark Bloom orbs are easy to dodge
everyone: Don't get knocked into puddles by Void Blast
tank: Use a defensive for Void Blast

bosses.name: Atroxus
positioning: Stay close to the boss so the random-target Noxious Breath frontal is easy to dodge
The tank kites the Toxic Creeper away from the group
tank: Kite the Toxic Creeper after Monstrous Roar: each hit stacks Sickening Bite, which makes Hulking Claw lethal
healer: Poison Splash is the group damage
damage: Swap to the Toxic Creeper; it pulses damage while alive

bosses.name: Charonus
positioning: Spread loosely for Cosmic Crash
Point Dark Waves away from the group
When Void Cascade fires, its target runs from the boss while everyone else clears the path
Kite Gravitic Orbs through an Unstable Singularity to destroy both
everyone: Don't get pulled into an Unstable Singularity
tank: Use a defensive for Dark Waves
healer: Unstable Singularity pulses damage while it lasts
damage: Gravitic Orbs fixate damage dealers; clear Condensed Mass stacks with a defensive or freedom

enemies.name: Aegyra the Unyielding
enemies.threat: Champion's Spear tethers everyone before Savage Smash
everyone: Kill Champion's Spear fast, then spread for Savage Smash
Move toward the outside when Ferocious Leap bleeds you; Earthsplitter follows it

enemies.name: Raj'kess the Spellstorm
enemies.threat: Thundering Storm channel and Orbs of Disruption
healer: Thundering Storm is heavy channelled damage
damage: Kill each Orb of Disruption before its cast finishes

enemies.name: Devouring Brutalizer
enemies.threat: Devour heals it from a low-health ally
everyone: Don't get pushed into another pack by Dreadbellow
tank: Brutalize channels into you: defensive
damage: Kill the low-health enemy Devour targets before the cast ends

enemies.name: Watchful Harrower
enemies.threat: Sky Strike soak and Void Beam
everyone: Stack in Sky Strike to split it, then run out of the AoE after
healer: Focus the Void Beam target

enemies.name: Brutal Overseer
everyone: Avoid Macestorm and run if it fixates you
damage: Break its shield during Brutal Slams to stop the damage

enemies.name: Voidtouched Magi
everyone: Move away from the group when Null Eruption targets you

enemies.name: Agitated Voidscythe
tank: Rip And Slice: defensive or bleed cleanse
healer: Poison dispel Corrosive Essence or use a cooldown

enemies.name: Chitigoth
enemies.threat: Insidious Aura channel and roaming swarms
healer: Insidious Aura is group damage

enemies.name: Brutok
tank: Move it as little as possible
Aim Smashing Charge at a wall
Head Bash knocks you back: defensive

enemies.name: Dominated Brawler
tank: Watch Bloodsurge stacks; soothe, stun, or kite

enemies.name: Voidminder
everyone: Interrupt or crowd control Mending Void

enemies.name: Enthralled Shaman
damage: Kill Magma Totem fast; spare kicks on Lava Bolt

enemies.name: Protective Turtle
everyone: Stay away while Shell Guard is up
damage: Hit it hard while it's stunned

enemies.name: Blistercreep
everyone: Dodge the circles it leaves when it dies

bosses.name: The Hoardmonger
positioning: Step out of the frontal slam
Spread the Rotten Mushroom soaks around the room
everyone: At 90%, 70%, and 40% the boss runs to a resource pile: send it to meat first, bone second, mushroom last
Grab each Rotten Mushroom within 12 seconds or it causes Putrid Burst; share the soaks
healer: The bellow gains a knockback and DoT after the meat pile
Dispel Toxic Spores if you can

bosses.name: Sentinel of Winter
positioning: The floor is slippery: plan moves early
Stack together to bait Raging Squall into one spot, then rotate around the room
Keep the boss near an add's snow pile so Frozen Tempest doesn't push you back
everyone: One player takes the Rimeshatter soak when an add dies into a snow pile
healer: Dispel Glacial Torment fast
Frozen Tempest ticks on everyone
damage: Kill the adds and interrupt their Winter's Shroud

bosses.name: Nalorakk
positioning: Stay away from echoes; Spectral Slash hits anyone close
Drop Echoing Maul echoes next to existing ones without clipping allies
During Fury Of The War God, form a wall around the boss in the middle of the room to block the charging echoes
During Overwhelming Onslaught, stand behind the shield the boss creates
everyone: Never let Forceful Slam or a charging echo reach the boss: it triggers Demoralizing Scream
tank: Keep your back away from echoes
After the Onslaught knockback, run back in to soak Forceful Slam
healer: Overwhelming Onslaught lands three big hits

enemies.name: Loa Speaker Nanea
everyone: Move Earthquake away from the group, overlapping old puddles
damage: Destroy each Volatile Totem at once

enemies.name: Spirit of Hunger
healer: Feast of Misery is channelled group damage
damage: Kill Starvation Effigy to cut Insatiable Hunger

enemies.name: Avatar of Determination
enemies.threat: Glacial Tomb roots everyone, then Pulverize
everyone: Break the ice or use a freedom, then run from Pulverize

enemies.name: The Winter Squall
enemies.threat: Harsh Winter pulses until it dies
everyone: Killing it ends the Harsh Winds gauntlet

enemies.name: Grizzled Warbringer
healer: Primal Echo hits the group

enemies.name: Earthwhisper Tender
everyone: Interrupt every Healing Breeze; purge if one lands

enemies.name: Stormbound Mystic
everyone: Interrupt every Arc Lightning; spare kicks on Lightning Bolt

enemies.name: Territorial Matriarch
tank: Mother's Wrath stacks: defensives or soothes

enemies.name: Glacial Revenant
everyone: Move off the Snowdrift it leaves on death
healer: Magic dispel Cryo Surge

enemies.name: Ruthless Totemcaller
damage: Kill Magma Totem fast

enemies.name: Bonded Beasttamer
enemies.threat: Bestial Wrath enrages it and its Saberfang
tank: Soothe Bestial Wrath

bosses.name: Adderis and Aspix
positioning: Spread loosely for Gale Force lines
Back onto a wall to stop the Gale Force knockback if you can't cancel it
Take Tempest Winds puddles away from the group
everyone: Storm Blessed immunity swaps between the bosses at 40%
After the knockback, collapse into melee to split Thunder And Lightning
Aspix's Frenzy speeds up everything once Adderis dies
tank: Defensive when Adderis gains Overload
healer: Spot heal Gust targets

bosses.name: Merektha
positioning: Stack in melee for Knot of Snakes so one AoE stun breaks it
Drop Thunder Spit circles at the edge
Tank Storm Serpents by old puddles or the edge
everyone: Don't get knocked into puddles during Serpentstorm
tank: Defensive for every Lightning Bite
healer: Serpentstorm is the big group damage
Poison dispel DoTs
damage: Interrupt the adds' Poison Spit and kill the burrow adds fast

bosses.name: Galvazzt
positioning: A non-tank steps between each Lightning Spire and the boss to stop his energy
The tank moves the boss to make spire soaks easy and to leave Induction puddles
everyone: If he hits full energy, Consume Charge likely wipes the group
healer: Spread healing cooldowns: the damage never stops

bosses.name: Avatar of Sethraliss
positioning: Drop Latent Hex puddles at the outside of the room
The healer kites Faithless Tormentor waves
everyone: Grab all three Corrupted Lifeforce soaks within 6 seconds
Interrupt the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock
tank: Defensive for Vile Charge and Tainted Strike
healer: Kite the Faithless Tormentors to avoid Shadowlash stacks
damage: Kill the Corrupted Guardian first, then stun and cleave Tormentors: each heals the Avatar

enemies.name: Agitated Nimbus
enemies.threat: Release Charge hits hard with stacks
tank: Defensive for Release Charge at high stacks

enemies.name: Imbued Stormcaller
enemies.threat: Imbued Conduction stuns when it expires

enemies.name: Twisted Hexxer
everyone: Take Latent Hex away from the group

enemies.name: Sandfury Stonefist
tank: Defensive for Sunder Slam

enemies.name: Sand-Sworn Rider
everyone: Stand close to dodge Scouring Sand

enemies.name: Krolusk Matriarch
everyone: Stand close to dodge Scouring Sand

enemies.name: Orb Watcher
tank: Defensive for Venomous Slash
healer: Caustic Stomp hits the group with a DoT

enemies.name: Shrouded Fang
everyone: Interrupt Poisoned Cheap Shot or poison dispel the stun

enemies.name: Faithless Subjugator
everyone: Interrupt or curse dispel Addle Mind

enemies.name: Faithless Tormentor
enemies.threat: Heals the Avatar if it lives
healer: Kite them to avoid Shadowlash
damage: Stun and cleave them

bosses.name: Lightblossom Trinity
positioning: Keep the bosses next to one of the three Fertile Loam circles
Lightsower Dash runs a line through all three circles: stay off it
After Lightblossom Beam, move the bosses off the Light-Scorched Earth before Bedrock Slam
everyone: Step into the circles during Lightblossom Beam so Lightbloom Overgrowth stays small
Move away from allies when Thornblade targets you, then out when Lekshi jumps
tank: Defensive for Bedrock Slam
damage: Rotate interrupts on Kezkitt's Light Bolt

bosses.name: Ikuzz the Light Hunter
positioning: When Bloodthirsty Gaze fixates you, kite the boss over roots to destroy them
For Verdant Stomp, group near the boss so roots are easy to cleave and nobody is pushed into one
everyone: Avoid Bloodthorn Roots; freedom or cleave anyone rooted
healer: Thorncaller Roar pulses group damage; it gets worse at 50% with Lightcrazed Frenzy

bosses.name: Lightwarden Ruia
positioning: Before 70%, players with Lightfire stack together so the tornadoes are easy to dodge
Spread when Pulverizing Strikes targets you
Avoid Lightfall circles
everyone: Interrupt Warden's Wrath to cut tank damage
tank: From 70% to 40%, Grievous Thrash bleeds you: self-heal, cleanse, or defend

bosses.name: Ziekket
positioning: Keep the boss and adds near the platform edge: the Concentrated Lightbeam puddle is large
everyone: Soak Lightbloom's Essence orbs before they reach the boss, spreading them so the DoT doesn't stack
tank: Thornspike: defensive or bleed cleanse
healer: Oozing Xylem pulses for the whole fight
damage: Cleave the adds and kick Lightspore Shot; hit their bodies with Concentrated Lightbeam to remove them for good

enemies.name: Potatoad Matriarch
enemies.threat: Toxic Spew group DoT and egg adds
tank: Tongue Toss launches you high: mind where you land
healer: Poison dispel as many Toxic Spew DoTs as you can
damage: Kill the Toadspawn eggs before they hatch

enemies.name: Radiant Spellsower
enemies.threat: Light Bolt Volley and Call The Grove
damage: Stun and kill it before it wakes Dormant Lashers at low health

enemies.name: Overgrown Hydra
enemies.threat: Lightmaw Beams channel into three players
everyone: Stay apart when Lightmaw Beams hits; dodge Bullet Seeds lines

enemies.name: Sporeblight Belcher
healer: Cooldowns for Spouting Floret

enemies.name: Luminous Thornmaw
enemies.threat: Solar Breath frontal and Grievous Gash
tank: Grievous Gash bleeds: cleanse or self-heal

enemies.name: Virid Grovekeeper
tank: Place Earthrupture Strike puddles away from the group

enemies.name: Lightgorged Lasher
damage: Focus it while it's shielded

enemies.name: Underbrush Stalker
healer: Focus the Thornblade target

bosses.name: Rav'i
positioning: Before Ssscavenging, the tank moves the boss onto the Bone Pile with no Twinfang corpse on it
Spread loosely for Triple Shot
everyone: During Ssscavenging, grab every Messy Eater soak and burst the shield
Dodge Regurgitate waves; disease dispel anyone hit
tank: A wrong Bone Pile means Feeding Frenzy
Hydrastrike melee hits hard

bosses.name: The Writhing Coil
positioning: Point Venom Jet away, then step out
Step out of the Burrowing Charge line
Stack the Uncoiled Writhes after Death Rattle so they're stunned and cleaved together
Dodge the Undermining lines after they recoil in the middle
everyone: Snap Death Rattle tethers fast with movement abilities
Interrupt every Toxic Atrophy; stun if kicks are down
healer: Synchronized Venom ticks most of the fight
damage: Save cooldowns for the Uncoiled Writhes

bosses.name: Zul'jan
positioning: Soak the four beams aimed at the boss during Ritual of the Fang
Stand in one of the two Boneslicer casts to clear Ritual Venom
Dodge the three spinning Axegrinder axes
everyone: Clear Ritual Venom before it expires; Bloodletting physical damage also clears it but leaves a puddle
tank: Defensive for Chop Down; it drops puddles if you still have Ritual Venom

enemies.name: Ritual Chieftain
enemies.threat: Blood Sacrifice and pulsing totem damage
tank: Dismember: defensive
healer: Blood Sacrifice hits the group and leaves a heal absorb

enemies.name: High Evolutionist
enemies.threat: Evolve turns Envenom into Mass Envenom
healer: Poison dispel Envenom

enemies.name: Ascendant Serpent
enemies.threat: Mini boss with Infest and tornadoes
everyone: Spread for Infest, then group to cleave Hatchlings
tank: Aim Noxious Spray away and defend through the push

enemies.name: Ula'tek's Chosen
healer: Toxic Surge pulses group damage

enemies.name: Twinfang Harrower
tank: Face Toxic Breath away; Duostrike hits hard
healer: Dispel Paralyzing Shots

enemies.name: Rattling Writhe
tank: Corrosive Fangs: defensive
healer: Rattle is channelled group damage

enemies.name: Living Venom
everyone: Stagger kills so the healer can recover between bursts

enemies.name: Ravenous Descendant
tank: Reset Ravenous with soothes or stuns

bosses.name: Melidrussa Chillworn
positioning: Stay grouped so Hailburst ice lands in one spot, then rotate around the room
Move away from the group when Chillstorm targets you
everyone: At 66% and 33% she shields with Ice Bulwark: save damage to end Frost Overload fast
tank: Pick up the Infused Whelps
healer: Heal the Chillstorm target through the pull-in
damage: Interrupt Frigid Shard to cut tank damage

bosses.name: Kokia Blazehoof
positioning: Take Ritual of Blazebinding to open space away from the group
Bait Molten Boulder away from your path
tank: Defensive for every Searing Blows
healer: The Blazebound Firestorm's Inferno hits the group
damage: Interrupt Blaze Volley and kill the Blazebound Firestorm

bosses.name: Kyrakka and Erkhart Stormvein
positioning: Winds of Change cycles north-west, south-west, south-east, north-east: drop Inferno Spit so the wind blows it away from you
Dodge Roaring Flamebreath when Kyrakka lands
everyone: At 50% Erkhart mounts and Inferno Spit hits three players: pool cooldowns for it
Stop casting when Interrupting Cloudburst starts
tank: Stormslam leaves a magic debuff
healer: Dispel the tank's Stormslam debuff before the next one

enemies.name: Blazebound Destroyer
everyone: Get 20 yards out before Burnout finishes
tank: Defensive for Inferno; spare kicks on Fiery Blast

enemies.name: Flamegullet
tank: Defensive for Fire Maw

enemies.name: Thunderhead
tank: Defensive for Thunder Jaw and its knockback
healer: Stagger Rolling Thunder dispels

enemies.name: Defier Draghar
everyone: Bait Blazing Rush into a wall
tank: Defensive for Steel Barrage

enemies.name: Primalist Cinderweaver
everyone: Take Living Bomb away from the group
healer: Dispel Living Bomb

enemies.name: Ruinous Stormbringer
everyone: Mind your position for the Thunderstorm knockback

enemies.name: Tempest Channeler
everyone: Defensive if Lightning Torrent targets you

enemies.name: Primal Juggernaut
tank: Defensive for Crushing Smash

enemies.name: Ashseer Flamelasher
everyone: Dodge Blaze of Glory swirlies, or purge to end it
tank: Stun Flaming Barrage
